arxiv-1912-05615.title: Rand-OFDM : A Secured Wireless Signal
arxiv-1912-05615.creator: Hesham Mohammed and Dola Saha
arxiv-1912-05615.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Hesham Mohammed and Dola Saha. Wireless communication has been a broadcast system since its inception, which violates security and privacy issues at the physical layer between the intended transmit and receive pairs. As we move towards advanced spectrum sharing methodologies involving billions of devices connected over wireless networks, it is essential to secure the wireless signal such that only the intended receiver can realize the properties of the signal.

arxiv-2303-14524.title: Chat-REC: Towards Interactive and Explainable LLMs-Augmented Recommender System
arxiv-2303-14524.creator: Yunfan Gao, Tao Sheng, Youlin Xiang, Yun Xiong, Haofen Wang, Jiawei Zhang
arxiv-2303-14524.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated their significant potential to be applied for addressing various application tasks. However, traditional recommender systems continue to face great challenges such as poor interactivity and explainability, which actually also hinder their broad deployment in real-world systems.

arxiv-2305-03539.title: NUMERICAL STUDY OF WEIBEL INSTABILITY DRIVEN BY ANISOTROPIC ELECTRON TEMPERATURE IN COLLISIONLESS PLASMAS
arxiv-2305-03539.creator: A. Sladkov, A. Korzhimanov
arxiv-2305-03539.description: Abstract We numerically investigate the process of generating magnetic fields from temperature anisotropy of electrons in collisionless initially uniform plasmas. We use a fully kinetic modeling and compare it against a hybrid modeling which treats ions kinetically and use ten-moment fluid model for electrons.

arxiv-2309-12410.description: Abstract We have studied a star-forming complex S193 using near-infrared (NIR) observations and other archival data covering optical to radio wavelengths. We identified stellar clusters in the complex using the NIR photometric data and estimated the membership and distance of the clusters.

arxiv-2410-16288.title: Challenges and Opportunities: Implementing Diversity and Inclusion in Software Engineering University Level Education in Finland

arxiv-2410-16288.description: Abstract Considerable efforts have been made at the high school level to encourage girls to pursue software engineering careers and raise awareness about diversity within the field. Similarly, software companies have become more active in diversity and inclusion (D&I) topics, aiming to create more inclusive work environments.

arxiv-2505-01719.title: Realization of all-to-all fermion propagator for the first principle high accuracy strong interaction prediction
arxiv-2505-01719.creator: Zhi-Cheng Hu, Ji-Hao Wang, Long Chen, Xiangyu Jiang, Liuming Liu, Shi-Hao Su, Peng Sun, Yi-Bo Yang
arxiv-2505-01719.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhi-Cheng Hu, Ji-Hao Wang, Long Chen, Xiangyu Jiang, Liuming Liu, Shi-Hao Su, Peng Sun, Yi-Bo Yang. We propose a “blending” algorithm that projects the all-to-all fermion propagator onto spatial low-frequency modes (LFM) combines the projection with a stochastic estimate of spatial high-frequency modes (SHFM) at each time slice. This approach enables the calculation of correlation functions at arbitrary points for arbitrary hadron states in strongly interacting quantum field theories (QFT) with fermions, such as quantum chromodynamics (QCD).
